channel_candidate.basis: A June 11, 2026 iHeart episode identifies the guest as Dr. Kamilah Stevenson. In the transcript she says her YouTube presence is 'doctor Camilla Stevenson' and explicitly warns that fake pages exist. The four Glasp-indexed videos are attributed to Kamilah Stevenson and their transcripts introduce the speaker as Camila Stevenson. This is strong consistency evidence, but no official cross-link from her authenticated social account to the exact YouTube channel ID was retrieved.
channel_candidate.caution: Do not include similarly named duplicate channels or assume every Kamilah/Camila/Camilla account is the same person.

The DailyCoin links confirm the video IDs and article-level attribution, not the canonical channel owner. The exact requested name 'Camilla Stephenson' does not match the indexed channel spelling 'Kamilah Stevenson'; the creator has reportedly warned about fake pages. No complete YouTube upload enumeration or official cross-link to channel ID UCqUPJMQdkCN6lsLVDnichPA was obtained.
scope_and_limits.do_not_infer: Do not infer that these four videos are the only uploads, that every indexed result is owned by the candidate channel, or that any video claim is independently verified.
